verdict.rationale: Reclaim.ai is a SaaS calendar product, so an official SDK is a fair question to ask, but the evidence pack never documents an official SDK. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The first-party remote MCP endpoint is a separate capability and does not count as an SDK, and llms.txt is only a docs index.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
